data: Is the Pearson correlation of the solid orange line higher than the solid red line in the top right graph at Layer Index 17?

The question asks whether the Pearson correlation of the solid orange line is higher than the solid red line in the top right graph at Layer Index 17. 

From the caption, we know that the solid orange line represents the model with batch centering, while the solid red line represents its counterpart without batch centering. The top right graph corresponds to the bert-large-uncased model.

At Layer Index 17, the solid orange line (with batch centering) appears to be above the solid red line (without batch centering). This suggests that the Pearson correlation for the model with batch centering is indeed higher than the one without batch centering at this layer index.

Therefore, the answer is yes, the Pearson correlation of the solid orange line is higher than the solid red line in the top right graph at Layer Index 17.
